objective: Systematically optimize the existing SM90 FP8-activation x MXFP4-weight persistent MegaMoE kernel on 8x NVIDIA H20 for the exact DeepSeek-V4-Flash model shape. Achieve a material win over the merged PR #383 FP8 path across the full M=8..8192 denominator, with special attention to the current M=16 and M=32 regressions. Study the inherited AichenF megamoe_nvfp4_dev_m implementation and generated SASS, use NCU/NSYS/CUPTI evidence to identify bottlenecks, and preserve the one-persistent-kernel MXFP4 design and exact model semantics.
fixed_constraints: The workload is exactly DeepSeek-V4-Flash: hidden=4096, intermediate_hidden=2048, num_experts=256, topk=6, world_size=8, FP8 activations, OCP MXFP4 routed weights, SwiGLU, activation_clamp=10, fast_math=1.
Evaluate every M in 8,16,32,64,128,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192; never substitute the MiMo 6144/2048/384/topk8 defaults.
Every candidate must pass exact-dequantized MXFP4 correctness before performance is comparable; do not loosen the FP4 tolerance or cosine/norm gates.
Use same-process same-input interleaved CUPTI cold-L2 measurements against the live PR #383 FP8 path; published PR #383 H20 times are diagnostic anchors only.
The success gate is every-row speedup >=1.05 and geometric-mean speedup >=1.10 versus the live FP8 path; optimize the minimum row first.
Do not use CUDA graphs, framework fallbacks, pre-expanded persistent FP8 weight copies, benchmark shortcuts, exact-output caches, or skipped synchronization.
Preserve the public Python/C++ ABI, 8-rank symmetric-buffer protocol, packed Mode2 Braided MXFP4 layout, and one persistent kernel launch.

Before each structural mutation inspect generated SASS/resource usage and record the hypothesis; use NCU after latency plateaus to distinguish WGMMA, TMA, decode, barrier, register, and occupancy limits.
Commit each correct measured improvement before starting the next risky experiment and keep changes within scope_paths.
